declarations.name: AuiDashboard
declarations.description:
AbsoluteUI Dashboard: renders a JSON dashboard definition:
`<aui-dashboard [(definition)]="definition" [editable]="true" (dashboardChange)="save()"></aui-dashboard>`.
`[(definition)]` follows every change (layout, widgets, undo, import) and `[(mode)]` the
view/edit switch. A new `definition` value is applied when it differs from the current one;
changing any other input re-creates the dashboard (undo history and kiosk mode start fresh).

inputs.name: registry
inputs.description: Widget types by name. Default: defaultWidgetRegistry (fill it with registerWidgetType or registerBuiltInWidgets).

inputs.name: transforms
inputs.description: Custom transforms for { op: 'custom', name }. Default: defaultTransformRegistry.

inputs.name: fetcher
inputs.description: (request, signal) => Promise<unknown>: performs data source requests and owns authentication. Default: defaultFetcher (global fetch, no redirects, JSON only, size-limited).

inputs.name: allowedOrigins
inputs.description: Exact http(s) origins besides the page origin that data sources may call. Invalid entries throw DASHBOARD_OPTIONS. Default: none.

inputs.name: baseUrl
inputs.description: Base for root-relative data source URLs and the 'same origin'. Default: location.href.

inputs.name: editable
inputs.description: Whether users may switch to edit mode; false hides the edit switch and refuses setMode('edit').

inputs.name: toolbar
inputs.description: Show the toolbar; an object turns items off (variables, refresh, edit, undo, reset, add, json, pages).

inputs.name: timeZone
inputs.description: IANA zone for date range presets and the 'Updated' time. Default: the runtime zone.

inputs.name: businessCalendars
inputs.description: Business calendars by the name date range variables refer to (business-day presets, date range picker).

inputs.name: label
inputs.description: Accessible name of the widget area. Default: '{title} widgets'.

inputs.name: lazy
inputs.description: Load a widget's data only when it comes within 200 px of the viewport (IntersectionObserver).

inputs.name: retries
inputs.description: GET retries on network errors, timeouts, 408, 429, and 5xx, with exponential backoff and jitter (integer 0 to 5).

inputs.name: locale
inputs.description: Locale of messages, numbers, and times.

inputs.name: direction
inputs.description: Direction of the grid, toolbar, tabs, and drawers.

models.name: definition
models.description: The dashboard definition (plain JSON). Older schemaVersions are migrated; invalid input throws DASHBOARD_DEFINITION with the first issue's JSON Pointer. Change it later with setDefinition().

models.name: mode
models.description: Initial mode; 'edit' needs editable: true. Change it with setMode().

methods.name: setVariable
methods.description: Validate and set a variable; dependent data sources reload. False for an unknown id or invalid value.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Reload one data source, or every source of the current page, bypassing the cache.

methods.name: undo
methods.description: Step back in the definition history (emits `dashboardChange`).

methods.name: redo
methods.description: Step forward in the definition history (emits `dashboardChange`).

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Return to the saved definition (undoable; emits `dashboardChange`).

methods.name: markSaved
methods.description: Make the current definition the one `reset()` returns to (call after storing it).

methods.name: addWidget
methods.signature: addWidget(widget: Omit<WidgetDefinition, "layout"> & { layout?: WidgetLayout; }): readonly DefinitionIssue[]
methods.description: Add a widget; returns issues (empty when added).

methods.name: updateWidget
methods.signature: updateWidget(id: string, widget: WidgetDefinition): readonly DefinitionIssue[]
methods.description: Replace a widget's definition; returns issues (empty when applied).

methods.name: removeWidget
methods.description: Remove a widget and its layout entries.

methods.name: startKiosk
methods.description: Read-only display without toolbar and tabs; optional page rotation and full screen.

methods.name: check
methods.description: Migrate and validate a candidate definition without applying it (works before the first render).

accessibility.pattern: Composition: a group of toolbar controls (native controls of the AbsoluteUI components), optional WAI-ARIA APG Tabs for pages, and a labelled region of widgets (Dashboard Grid) whose widgets are labelled regions (Dashboard Widget). Editing uses the Dashboard Grid move handles; the builder is an APG modal Dialog (Drawer).

limitations: Chart widgets do not emit point selections, so cross-widget interactions work from list and table widgets and from custom widget types.
Built-in widgets cover KPI, line, bar, pie, bullet, gauge, sparkline, table, list, progress, and text; other charts and the Data Grid need a custom widget type.
Dashboard PNG and PDF export are not provided; charts keep their own SVG/PNG export.
Undo covers definition changes; variable values and page selection are not part of the history.
The builder form edits common fields; transforms, interactions, and thresholds are edited in its JSON tab.
Kiosk full screen works only when startKiosk is called from a user gesture.
Manual screen-reader verification (NVDA, JAWS, VoiceOver) is pending.

types.name: DashboardPageChangeDetail
types.description: Detail of `pageChange`: the page now shown.
